Booked NE - Arunachal Pradesh family package tour with them thru my friend's reference. In short , Arunachal is Gods Gift to India , you need to explore with the right travel agency. While all my pre-booking was good with Donniez Safari , there were key issues , which was not at all considered and they started playing with our emotions...
1. Day 1 : Local Trip in Guwahati : we were 9 of us , they gave an old Tempo which couldnt event go beyond 40Km / Hour , the driver himself was an acting driver...the guide her self accepted and told for next day they will arrange a better van.
2. Local Stay in Guwahati : They changed the hotel which was 20Km away as the prebooked guest house had water issues :-), they didnt even had break fast option , where that guide told she will arrange Poori , and she brought it around 10am , with Kids starving.
3. Vehicle to Arunachal : Any one would know its a ghat area and we would need to arrange a good Vehicle , these people for 9 of us arranged a Jeep kind (Force Cityline), which was cramped inside. While we spoke , Donniez team told , they will get us alternative in Tawang...This is their first Lie. They didnt even bother later inspite of our request and dragged this for 3 days until we started from Tawang to Dirang. Ultimate is the Tyre was bad and we had to change the same (wasted 30 mins) , as per our itenary we were to start to Sheragon by 10am , started at 2PM.
4. No Control / Worst Communication :
They changed the Hotel in Tawang , where we need to stay for 3 Nights , and booked us in a local lodge , but what they showed was initially a better one , we checked that as well. Worst point is they didnt even inform us , we came to know thru our Driver

5. On the Road : We booked our flights thru them , and while they knew from Dirang to Guwahati it would take 9 hours , they made an iternary in such a way we would have missed our flights. We had to loose one day stay in Dirang and paid one night stay back in Guwahati from our side. Basis this , these guys didnt pay the Vechile and that person stopped the Vechile in the road while coming and told , he will start only if the Donniez will pay to the travel van owner. We had to stay in the highway for 30 mins ...

My Request is if you want to enjoy your holiday , pls book good agent , even if you have to pay 10K or 20K more as a memorable trip.

Deeply Money Minded agency , No customer Care , All Wrong Commits and worst Management.
